definitions.explanation: To inflict pain or distress on someone.

examples.japanese: {病気|びょうき}が{彼|かれ}を{苦|くる}しめた。
{悩|なや}みが{心|こころ}を{苦|くる}しめる。

notes:
{苦|くる}しめる is a transitive ichidan verb meaning to torment or cause suffering to someone.

TRANSITIVE/INTRANSITIVE PAIR:
- {苦|くる}しめる ({他動詞|たどうし}): to torment, cause suffering
- {苦|くる}しむ ({自動詞|じどうし}): to suffer

CONJUGATION:
- {苦|くる}しめる (dictionary form)
- {苦|くる}しめない (negative)
- {苦|くる}しめた (past)
- {苦|くる}しめられる (passive)

COMMON SUBJECTS:
- {病気|びょうき}が〜を{苦|くる}しめる: illness torments ~
- {悩|なや}みが〜を{苦|くる}しめる: worries torment ~
- {思|おも}い{出|で}が〜を{苦|くる}しめる: memories torment ~

USAGE NOTE:
Can have people, illnesses, memories, or abstract concepts as the subject causing the suffering.
